657.synopsis:
Humanoid beast? Ahem….  Humanoid beast….
Because a female immortal sealed a mischievous and sly fox spirit into his right hand, ordinary senior high school student Liu Yi henceforth began his extraordinary journey as a immortal practitioner.
The fox spirit said:
“The prettiest girls in the class, the daughters of rich families, the evil female cult members, the beautiful women in the world of immortals? All these beauties are no longer a dream!
Come, become an immortal and even a diaosi could counterattack!
Come, become an immortal and kill all of the tall, rich and handsome!
Come, become an immortal and capture all the beauties!”
“Liu Yi, I said to capture all the beauties; not to capture me! Hey! Stop!”

3729.synopsis: A lecherous army special task force soldier from 21st-century Hong Kong is selected to travel back in time, choosing to go to the Chinese Warring States Period. Unfortunately, the time machine runs into an error during the experiment. With no foreseeable way to return to the present, he must use his combat skills and knowledge of history to thrive in his new life in the year 251 BC.

3985.synopsis:
For the wine to be drunk on her wedding night to actually have been a cup of poison and for the one to poison her to be her husband, who would believe it?
But such a thing had happened! And that was just the beginning of her bad luck.
On her wedding night, she goes from a new bride to an abandoned wife, and in the blink of an eye, she became a princess married off into the wilderness of the frigid North.
Though she is still a bride, whereas previously she was envied by everyone, now she only receives pity.
To preserve the life of another beautiful woman, she is exploited and becomes a dispensable pawn.
But she is not a weak person to be at anyone’s mercy. She will control her own fate!

4497.synopsis:
Some people are like a drug, once you get a taste of it, you are forever addicted.
A love story between two young men, from foes to a bickering couple, withstanding 8 years of separation, suffering and surviving hardships together. They are Gu Hai & Bai Luo Yin, in Chinese, when Hai & Luoyin are put together (Hailuoyin = 海洛因) means heroin, a substance that can be very addictive.
There’s a type of person who is like Heroin. Once you get involved, you can never let it go….
associated_names: คุณเสพติดความรักหรือเปล่า?

4753.synopsis:
Its been thousands of years since Lyle Walt saved the world and brought prosperity to the land.
But now humanity, having failed to fight against the monsters and almost all of humanity dying, they were forced to construct full walled colonies and avoid all contact with the outside world in fear of the monsters that now are the rulers of the world…
This is the story of Leo Walts, a descendant of Lyle Walts the hero and ruler. This all started once Leo picked up a blue jewel, and the first thing he heard was… My name is【Lyle Walt】, I am your ancestor.

5521.synopsis:
When gods gather, lightning will strike and the earth will move. Immortals! Which of the numerous way to immortality should one follow? Immortals are hard to seek, but why should immortals hide? Heaven has no mercy, but humans have emotions, and these emotions hinder the road to longevity!
Train the inner self to stay calm, train the external body to be resistant, then cross the three continents and four seas alone, and fight valiantly with demons and devils! With the heavenly baton in hand, raid the devils and demons without any resistance! Take one step to cross nine stars and chase the sword in the dreams! Traverse a thousand li of river and mountains in a single day! The exceptional beings do not mix with the ordinary! Within the universe, where can one find an obstacle! Moving like a dragon, with talent like a phoenix! The heavenly Daos and stars will guide one’s way!

6033.synopsis:
I died for some reason and was reborn as the princess of a kingdom. Father is a man who loves his daughter dearly and Mother is kind as long as you don’t anger her. There’s also the noisy maid who cares for me very much and a black-hearted siscon brother. I have no memories, but I might be able to spend my new life happily… if only the other countries stopped invading us, that is!
I shall recreate many magical tools in this world based on my remaining knowledge from my past life and defeat foreign enemies. I shall force the troublesome socializing to my older brother and live the leisure life of a princess! 
I’m going to survive the chaotic times and create the strongest nation in the world with the occasional cases of kidnapping and adventurer activities!
associated_names: Tensei Oujo no Kokka Dai Kaizou ~ Muteki na Kuni wo Tsukurimashou
転生王女の国家大改造 ~無敵な国を作りましょう~

8593.synopsis:
Felmenia Stingray was a genius mage. She quickly became the most distinguished mage of the Astel Kingdom after her discovery of white fire magic, which had the power to burn anything.
However, the world is in peril due to the Demon King. The kingdom’s court mages perform a summoning ritual for heroes and bring forth a hero and two youths, a boy and a girl. Unlike the girl, the young man refused to fight the Demon King alongside the Hero and demanded to be sent back to his world. The kingdom, angry with his behavior, locked him away.
Now Felmenia stands before the young man with her strongest magic, the white flame, being completely useless and asks who he is. It was already obvious to her that this man was far stronger than she was. To this he simply responds.
“Yakagi Suimei, a magician.”
associated_names: The Magic in this Other World is Too Far Behind! (LN)
異世界魔法は遅れてる! (LN)

9617.synopsis:
Nie Feng, a follower of the Ultimate Martial Path, unfortunately, perished while exploring an uninhabited region in Miao Jiang. However, he was unexpectedly reborn into the body of a profligate youth on the uncivilized Planet Grand Origin, a planet belonging to the Immortal Luo Empire. His new and legendary life would begin from this moment!
The collision of two Great Galactic Emperies, wars between thousands of Starforce Battleships, formidable Star Warriors, mysterious Star Warlocks, beautiful women capable of causing the downfall of nations, divine skills and martial arts capable of annihilating the Heavens and destroying the Earth.
In this mysterious and magnificent world, one might well ask; who is the Lord of this boundless Star Ocean!

10129.synopsis:
Happiness of the family >>>>>> World peace!? The curtain rises on another fantasy slice-of-life tale, brought to you by the “Hataraku Maou-sama!” team. 
On that day, an emergency family meeting was called to order at the residence of the Kenzaki family, an ordinary family living in Tokorozawa City. A blonde beauty named Dianaze Krone, Diana for short, had appeared from a different world, in the living room of the Kenzaki family. “I, an envoy, have come to summon the Hero of Salvation, Kenzaki Hideo.”
Wait, Hideo is my dad! To think such a game-like situation would fall upon me, Kenzaki Yasuo, an ordinary high school student. 
My father is a hero, and he saved a different world in his younger days!? There’s no way I can believe that this ordinary, middle-aged father of mine is a “Hero.” Diana looks at me, “The Son of the Hero” with a gaze filled with longing. My sister who saw that looks at me with a cold gaze… Before bringing back peace to the other world, the peace of our family is in big trouble! What is going to happen to my peaceful everyday life!?

11409.synopsis:
She, a 21st century mercenary queen, had crossed over into a tragically betrayed body of a waste. Waste? She will show them what it means to be a waste! Betrayed? With the Ancient Manual in her hands, she will astonish all the despicable men and cheap women! 
Wait! Didn’t everyone say that she was an evil woman which everyone feared? Why is his Third Highness, full of mystery and charisma, so interested in her?

13713.synopsis:
Bo Bing is a medical student who went to Japan to pursue further studies, a young girl in a foreign land she met a senior student, Ye Zheng Chen who is also an aspiring doctor in the same university as her. They shared some common factors, become fast friends and gradually fall in love. Ye Zheng Chen love Bo Bing deeply and affectionately call her ‘lass’ instead by her name. However, Bo Bing later discovered that Ye Zheng Chen is in fact already engaged to another girl and was upset she is being lied to. Ye Zheng Chen tried to explain his difficulties but Bo Bing fled back home before he can tell her the truth.
Three years later, Bo Bing’s fiancé is being charged and she is told that only Ye Zheng Chen has the ability to help her. Bo Bing is therefore being forced to trade herself to Ye Zheng Chen in order to save her fiancé. She also learns the secret that Ye Zheng Chen has been hiding from her since their days in Japan three years ago…

13969.synopsis:
Lived for the sword, died for the sword. 
There’s no regret in his lifetime一一 only one thing, but only admiration remained. 
One day Souma recovers his memory from the previous life, but also on the same day he was branded as an incompetent person.  
Denied by what he longs for …. However for Souma , it has nothing to do with him. 
一一I want to use magic. 
Ancient ruins, underground labyrinths, demon’s territory, forest of witch. 
If you hear something about magic, you head there without hesitation, this is the story of such a boy.
associated_names: I Surrendered My Sword for a New Life as a Mage (LN)
Moto Saikyou no Kenshi wa, Isekai Mahou ni Akogareru
元最強の剣士は、異世界魔法に憧れる
原最強劍士憧憬著異世界魔法

14225.synopsis:
Encountering a car crash, the King of Silver Screen, Ye Sinian, was bound to a Cannon Fodder Counterattack System.
After reincarnating for hundreds of lives, he has finally earned enough “travel expenses” to go back home.
However, he didn’t think that the system would suddenly malfunction, making returning back home from then on hopeless.
With the shackles of a millennium broken, Ye Sinian aggressively counterattacked!
Reversing fates while hugging the mentally ill* Lord Gong, he walked towards the apex of humanity!
*Mentally ill – Schizophrenic
associated_names: Hệ Thống Pháo Hôi Nghịch Tập

14481.synopsis:
The long war for supremacy between two neighboring nations came to an end.
For this reason, Raiz, the strongest tamer ever seen, was facing a difficult problem.
How could the multitude of monsters called to arms survive without  work to sustain them?
Worried, he decided to open a “shop” to find jobs for his comrades.
“Right! Let’s start our own guild!”
Even though at first people were afraid, seeing the monsters working so hard for their sake made them change their mind and after forgiving those creatures, the guild started receiving quite the number of requests.
“Nice, if we put our heart and soul in working we’ll make a fortune!”
That’s how the strongest tamer started a family business (with a ranch).
associated_names: Youkoso monsutaazu girudo ~ saikyou shuudan, nandemoya hajimemashita ~
ようこそモンスターズギルド～最強集団、何でも屋はじめました～

14993.synopsis:
One morning, after being bound to the system, MC started his routine of always being captured/ attacked by the ML.
It doesn’t matter if he transmigrated into the ML’s little disciple brother or master or opponent, but in the end he is still forcibly taken by the ML.
After transmigrating to many worlds:
MC: Come out system!!! The heck?! Why do these MLs not love their female goddesses, but insist on doing it with me! Aaaaahh!!!
System: …. __(:3」∠)_ Don’t ask me, I also don’t know.
associated_names: Xuyên việt luôn bị nam chủ công lược
Zǒng shì bèi nán zhǔ gōnglüè de chuānyuè rìcháng
总是被男主攻略的穿越日常

16273.synopsis:
We do not belong to the light nor do we belong to the darkness, we walk the line in between.
There will be no people singing our praises or bards retelling our heroism but we will have pride in our work.
– Law of the Demon Hunter, Prologue

17553.synopsis:
After being reborn she worked hard to stalk and marry her husband, ab*se and punish her other s*umbag husband, and embark on a journey to reach the pinnacle of life!
—
For the egregious crime of treason everyone in the Xiao House were sentenced to death.
At the execution grounds while waiting to be beheaded, she stared at the youth sprawled on the ground in front of her. He had run over so hurriedly he tripped over his own feet, displaying an undignified sight. It made her smile thinking how s*upid this person was. She had completely used and taken advantage of him from the day he forced her to marry him. Yet despite all the ab*se she heaped on him, he still wanted to save her.
She opened her eyes again only to find it was the day before their wedding. 
That devious scoundrel… to make her his wife through underhanded methods… 
The memory of it still left a bad taste in her mouth.
She was going to grab this second chance and live it up! 
Extort all debts owed to her! 
Buff herself up and shine like a diamond!   
But how was she to know that the husband she once hated was actually really loyal and gentle, soft and easy, and so incredibly sweet and delicious to eat! The shutters that blinded her eyes in the previous life were cast aside. She realized she didn’t know how to cherish the good things in life. So in this new one she was going to make sure to pamper and spoil the hell out of that husband of hers.

18577.synopsis:
As a member of the popular combination, the famous traffic in the entertainment circle, Xiaosu Luosu, girlfriend powder, sister powder, and pro-mother powder all over the entertainment circle, is the only one who has a delicate body and has no acting skills in the north and south of the river.
However, who can think of it from the best idol to the unpopular star that nobody cares about overnight.
However, Luo Su, who was born again, found that Ji Yunshen, a film singer who studied the acting skills, was known as the ‘old play bone’, had a soft spot for him.
The prestigious director’s character is so strange and odd, but he is addicted to him.
The fervent little boy who is very popular is hot on his search.
The paparazzi who mastered the direction of the entertainment circle became his ‘dog leg’.
However, all this is no match –
The film emperor actually became his value powder.
Luo Su: This is impossible, the cold movie king can not be so superficial!
Film Emperor: I am actually a face value party.
associated_names: After Rebirth, All the Male Gods Are Into Me
Chóngshēng hòu nán shénmen dōu kàn shàngle wǒ
重生后男神们都看上了我

19601.synopsis:
After ten years on the battlefield, Teng Yun sees Xue Junliang protecting his country and conquering new territory, while he himself ends up with an arrow through his heart. When he wakes up, he becomes that man’s Ugly Empress.
This is about a Prince who is captured as prisoner and killed, then he is reborn as his enemy country’s ugly empress. With his black-bellied King of a husband, they love and hate each other. They use every possible method. Chickens fly and dogs jump, from imperial harem to imperial court there is no peace. In the end, they bring peace and stability to the country.
————
(The complete novel translation can be read on Chrysanthemum Garden)

20113.synopsis:
How pitiful is a life without love?
In every happy ending, there is always a male character who either meets his demise or spends the rest of his life alone.
Maybe he regards feelings as playthings, or maybe he doesn’t care. When the whole world turns its back on him, will there be someone… someone who turns their back on the world, to take his hand?
I love you.
Your dreams,
Your strengths,
and your flaws.
These are the stories of said male characters and their special someones.

22929.synopsis: Suspicious cases, blood and family tangles.

23953.synopsis:
Chen Mo a game designer got sent to a parallel world with advance technology but undeveloped game concepts.
Watch as he redefines the world’s gaming industry with the games he remade from his old world.

27025.synopsis:
Yin Yin was a female side character in 《All Splendor Fades》. She embodied every deranged trait a villainess should have and relentlessly sabotaged the protagonists’ relationship with clumsy and ridiculous schemes. In the end, the male protagonist blocked her without hesitation.
Lin Xin’er’s review: Severely lacking in intelligence.
And so, Lin Xin’er transmigrated into the story.
Du Qianqian was the female protagonist of 《All Splendor Fades》. A sanctimonious white lotus with a brain even more fragile than the villainess’s. In the end, driven to despair by the female side character’s torment, she jumped off a cliff.
Lin Xin’er’s review: She deserved to die.
But Du Qianqian was reborn.
Lin Xin’er was a reader of 《All Splendor Fades》 and a leftover woman from the 21st century whose biggest hobby— and profession— was scamming people.
Unfortunately, she transmigrated into the novel and became Yin Yin.
——Perhaps life was nothing more than a meticulously arranged chess game, and the real player…… was someone else entirely.

28561.synopsis: Xiao Qingrong thought he was going to die, but he wasn’t dead. The former male god system was transformed to a scum-washing system. In order to take care of this crying system 618, Xiao Qingrong once again embarked on the road of beating …

30097.synopsis:
In the jianghu, who can resist a bit of flirting?
Aloof, protective, and proud young disciple gong X trouble-prone, reckless, death-defying and seemingly straight-laced but actually carefree shifu.
Once you enter the jianghu, the years fly by.
“The world is a battlefield; wherever the jianghu exists, so do the cycles of vengeance and retribution. You either flourish or die.” Many years ago, when young Chu Xiwei first joined the sect, he heard these words, and they chilled him to the bone like a blanket of snow.
After scaring the young disciple, Ye Fusheng leisurely took a sip of his tea and said, “Everything I just told you is nonsense.”
This is a story of a carefree and flirtatious shifu digging up old grievances and adventures in the jianghu. It’s also a romantic tale of a loyal and proud disciple who follows his shifu through life and death without ever giving up.
After the storm, the splendor fades to ash. With it, the Graceful Phantom blade is sealed away from the world.

30609.synopsis:
The female General Tuoba Yan was chosen by the emperor in the northwest and summoned to the capital to serve as his queen. She spent the first half of her life on the battlefield to protect her home and the country but was mu*dered by the women in harem secretly. 
Originally, she thought that it was a farewell to the world, but General Tuoba’s consciousness occupied the body of the suicidal girl Tuoba Yan.
And, to complete Tuoba Yan’s last wish, she chose to step into the entertainment circle as a martial arts substitute and fight all the way up, swearing to never falter!
associated_names: Nữ võ thế giới giải trí

30865.synopsis:
The end of mankind and its doom was right around the corner. Narvas, a giant asteroid, was on the path to colliding with earth. To avoid mankind impending doom, Kiwoo broke through the miraculous odds and  journeyed through the ages of time.
“…Native Americans?”
However, much to his expectations, Kiwoo arrived in the native lands before the discovery of the New World! For man to survive, civilization needed to develop faster and quicker before the collision of Narvas occurs. Under his guidance, the native land was reborn as an empire of the natives and not as colonial land ruled under eurocentrism.

31121.synopsis:
To save his slaughtered buddies, Bao Ye sacrifices himself to transmigrate back in the past to rewrite their fate.
However, he has mistakenly transmigrated back to 30 years ago—the year when he hasn’t been born yet.
What’s worse, the body he possesses is a despicable, wretched, lousy, cheap villain, who even betrays his families and friends. Meanwhile, that villain is an extremely ugly, and most inferior s*ave.
Normally, people like him should be the last eye-catcher, however, a powerful man invades in Bao Ye’s life. The guy takes going against him as his job, and makes fun out of embarrassing him.
The most bullsh*t thing is, during the long-time confrontation, that man falls in love with him.
Touching his super ugly face, Bao Ye is shocked, “What the hell…how could this dude get enchanted by this face? He is really hardcore!”

32657.synopsis:
Su Yan, being a model citizen, was unexpectedly chosen by a mysterious System one day.
Su Yan: Why me?
System: Because you are a good woman.
Su Yan: #%*…
From then on, Su Yan traveled through different worlds, redeeming all kinds of bad women, but…
Why does she end up being completely taken advantage of by the Male Lead every time? Where is the promised distance and self-control? What happened to not getting close to women? You said you hated me, right? I just want to redeem myself!

33169.synopsis:
Royle was a member of a S-Rank Adventurers Party. As an enchanter, he was responsible to adjust equipment of party members.
But one day,
“We are the strongest party, even without your enchantment.”
He was fired from the party.
Forcefully he restarted his life in a remote area.
He could make weapons that let amateurs released power beyond their standard. Using that kind of weapon, he who had no fighting experience could increase it rapidly.
On the other hand, his previous party, which lose his enchantment ability, started to lose their power and authority.
associated_names: Party wo tsuiho sareta soubi seisakusha, jitsuwa sekai saikyo ~ solo ni nattanode, jibun de tsukutta saikyo soubi de musou suru ~
パーティーを追放された装備製作者、実は世界最強　〜ソロになったので、自分で作った最強装備で無双する〜

33681.synopsis:
Luan Qingxiao became a member of the Plot Amendment Research Institute, and already encountered a hurdle on her first mission.
She was to play the role of the antagonist, who would become the fuel the male and female lead needed to finally fall in love. However, the results from her work are unacceptable, the white lotus female lead is developing feelings toward her…
Nie Zhen’er’s face is like a delicate peach blossom. Remaining shy, and frightened to leave, with her eyes and red lips gently open: Qingxiao, I like you.
Luan Qingxiao: … I do too!
Who would be willing to reject such a beauty?
System 520: Wait, wait a minute! What is this situation?!
1. [Campus Hipster] , the school bully x the campus belle √
520: Great Host, you must bully her, humiliate her, frame her, it’s crucial that the male lead saves her in these situations!
Luan Qingxiao: No problem.
…
520: Great Host, the situation doesn’t seem quite right, why would the female lead like the girl who bullied her, humiliated her, and framed her??
Luan Qingxiao lowered her eyes and smiled softly: because she understands me.
World 1. Vicious female supporting role school bully x white lotus school beauty √
World 2. Apocalyptic scientist x humanoid beauty zombie king √
World 3. Vicious master x beauty furnace tripod raised by the master √
World 4. Female tyrant x little phoenix flying on the branch √
World 5. Bai Feng x Peach Fairy √
…
Fake aloofness, real gentleness, vicious female supporting role [top] X real beauty, fake weakness, white lotus [bottom]
associated_names: 恶毒女配与白莲花［快穿］

34449.synopsis:
Minus Skill. A negative de-buff possessed by a select few since birth. A swordsman who has one such skill is once again in the throes of being thrown out of another party. Despite his abilities, that single skill had a huge downside, which would make him a burden to any would-be adventuring partners. Sick and tired of the never-ending cycle, he has taken it upon himself to challenge a dungeon that may possess an item that could remove a skill of his. There, he meets a girl with the Priestess class who also has a Minus Skill but… 
–Eh? Aren’t our skills synergistic? Negatives coming together to form a positive!
This is the story of people exiled from parties, who possess Minus Skills, banding together to eventually become the strongest party.
associated_names: Minus Skill-mochi Yonin ga Atsumattara, Nanka Synergy Hakki Shite Saikyou Party ga Dekita Ken
The Case of the Four who Possess a Minus Skill When Gathered Together, Exhibited a Synergy that Created the Strongest Party
The Chronicles of the Misfit Quartet and Their Unrivaled Synergy
マイナススキル持ち四人が集まったら、なんかシナジー発揮して最強パーティーができた件

34705.synopsis:
Before the creation of Disboard—a world where everything is decided by games—there raged an eternal war that tore apart the stars. The notorious Immanity weren’t the only ones who sought to bring an end to the Great War, by their owns means of play. However, some played by different rules—such as the future a certain Elf envisioned: “If you kill all the stars and remain standing, you win.” In other words—“anything goes!” In addition to the newly-written story of “another end of the war” following Think Nirvalen, this special volume also holds the many erratic short stories included in the anime’s bonus features!
“Now—let the war begin~”
associated_names: ノーゲーム・ノーライフ プラクティカルウォーゲーム

36241.synopsis:
The various extras from the Daomu Biji universe
Extra 1: 2009 Chinese New Year Special
Extra 2: 2014 Chinese New Year Special
Extra 3: 2015 Chinese New Year Special
Extra 4: The Mystic Nine’s Chen Pi Ah Si Extra
Extra 5: 2016 Chinese New Year Special
Extra 6: 2017 Chinese New Year Special
Extra 7: 2018 Chinese New Year Special
Miscellaneous extras

40081.synopsis:
When the Arpen Empire decided to no longer wage war, small countries nearby could finally breathe. But this peace was meant to be shattered, for soon after, envoys were sent to each country issuing a golden decree to each of the royal families.
“To establish an alliance with the Arpen Empire, each kingdom must send a princess to become a Crown Princess Candidate. The princesses will undergo six months of training to divide them into those who have the potential to become empress and those who will be concubines. Any kingdom disobeying the imperial edict shall be seen as enemies and their access to the River Judith’s stream will be blocked.”
“The God of Judith” was an age-old love song that had been sung from generation to generation. The ballad passed from the grandma’s lips to the little girl’s, from her to another, and another… etching a place in time. But this was no tale of admiration and envy, for all whose ears it reached agreed that the God of Judith was foolish.
Standing by the banks, a woman gazed at the River Judith before her…  where the god may have stood thousands of years ago, her hand resting on her heart, a suffocating feeling clutching at her.
“The god isn’t the only one who’s foolish… Humans are the same as well… You and I.”
Viola’s long-cherished dream was not to marry and be someone’s wife but be hailed as the queen of the Kingdom of Koronis. She longed for the crown, even more after losing her only flesh and blood in the war. Once a half-royal, she struck a deal with the king to restore her status. It was a political marriage to the Crown Prince of the Arpen Empire.
“I’m going to be a queen, and I will take my identity back.”

41617.synopsis:
After becoming the Kun-Lai Sect Leader, Ji Yunlai discovers there’s always “protagonists” appearing, coveting his spiritual artifacts, his apprentice, his daughter, Kun-Lai Sect……
Note: the daughter is not biologically related.

42897.synopsis:
Henry, born in a royal family without skills, is given territory on the border. It’s a grassland full of monsters,, with no people, no resources, and no hope.
Disheartened, Henry wanders the grasslands and falls underground through a hole. However, the moment he touches a stone monument there, words echo in his mind.
It is a mysterious dungeon filled with ancient items, traps, and malevolence. If you die inside, you lose your status and have to start over, but that doesn’t matter to Henry’s off-the-charts skill, “Maintain Status”. No matter how many times he dies, he can always grow and start over.
Henry will die again today. All for the sake of developing his territory with dungeon clear rewards.
associated_names: Banishing Prince of Outlying Skills, Infinite Growth in Mysterious Dungeons
Hazure Skill no Tsuihou Ouji, Fushigi na Dungeon de Mugen Seichou
外れスキルの追放王子、不思議なダンジョンで無限成長

44177.synopsis:
Lu Shui, the Lu family’s only son, received an order from the clan elder today: go to the Mu family and break off the engagement.
Rumor had it that the Mu family’s heaven-blessed prodigy suddenly lost all her cultivation overnight and became worthless tr*sh, which left the Lu clan’s higher-ups extremely dissatisfied. They wanted to annul the engagement and find a better match.
An ordinary guy like Lu Shui didn’t refuse.
However, when Lu Shui arrived at the Mu family and saw his fiancée, he was dumbfounded. It turned out that his fierce, hard-to-get-along-with wife from his previous life has also been reborn.
associated_names: My Fierce Dao Companion Was Also Reborn

44689.synopsis:
How does it feel to find out that all your dorm mates are big shots on your first day of school?
Hao Yun has the most say in this matter.
Having been chosen by the Otherworldly Expert System, he unexpectedly obtains the ability to see the future potential of others. He discovers that his roommates are all future big shots with explosive potential.
Then why should he work hard?
Wouldn’t just being cozy with them solve all problems?
Normal people would think that way, and Hao Yun is no exception.
However, just when Hao Yun thinks that he can easily become a winner in life as long as he cozies up with them, he surprisingly finds these so-called big shots are quite fragile.
And these great artists, superstars, academics, and the richest people in the world, who finally reach the pinnacle of their lives with the help of “coincidences”, can’t help but feel lucky when they are interviewed. They are glad that they had such a hidden expert by their side…
Hao Yun: Great, after all this, I am actually your fortuitous encounter!

45457.synopsis:
Former Japanese Chris reincarnated in a different world as the third son of a poor aristocrat, dreaming of a slow life.

Later, I left the capital for two years. When I returned and saw him again, I respectfully called him “Cousin,” then walked behind him and grabbed the ear of the young general who had just returned from the battlefield:
“Bo Ji An! I told you not to drink because your wound hasn’t healed. Why are you ignoring the doctor’s orders again!”

86417.synopsis:
True Destined Son of Heaven: Reigning Supreme in the Universe!
They have supreme old experts as teachers, magical treasures by their side, and bargains on old street markets turn out to be divine weapons…	
“Yet, none of that matters.”
“No matter how good their cheats, a single card can knock them down! No matter how great their destiny, they fear burning money!”	
Chu Tianxiao opened the Great Prodigal System and muttered, “Moreover, I just spent 500 billion to buy the Great Thousand Worlds…”
“Here, there is no place for you Destined Sons of Heaven to show off!”	
…
Yes, this is a story about a prodigal son, who, while lavishly squandering wealth, effortlessly crushes a group of True Destined Sons of Heaven.

86929.synopsis:
Reincarnated as the son of the Duke in the Qi Dynasty, Fang Wang’s mind housed a Heavenly Palace, where his consciousness could enter to cultivate. He could practice any cultivation technique or secret art to great perfection, only emerging when it was truly perfect. No matter how long he spent in the Heavenly Palace, in reality, it was but a moment’s time.
At the tender age of sixteen, Fang Wang stumbled upon the mythic realm of martial arts, unbeknownst to anyone else.
However…
One day, Fang Wang overheard whispers that Zhou Xue, the foster daughter of his uncle, had gone mad, prophesying doom for the Fang household.
Curiosity piqued, Fang Wang stealthily approached Zhou Xue’s room, catching her muttering to herself, “Sigh, even as a former celestial dignitary, I find myself powerless to alter the fate of my family. Is the heavens playing tricks on me… If only I could rewind time by just one month…”
A reincarnated celestial dignitary? Fang Wang’s perception shattered, a mix of shock and excitement washing over him.
Who needs martial arts when you can ascend to immortality?
Embarking on a journey spanning the vast landscapes, Fang Wang sought the one celestial art in the mortal realm capable of turning one into an immortal god.
associated_names: I Became An Immortal On Mortal Realm (Official Webnovel.com)
I will become an immortal in this world

87953.synopsis:
Aiba Hashiru is a hero who was summoned to another world. After defeating the Demon King, he returned to his original world due to some troubles, and returns to his former life as a new teacher with his abilities as a Hero warrior.
However, among his students, there are those who fight against monsters, aliens, and a mysterious criminal organization. 
This is a story about the life of a former hero, who doesn’t particularly hide or hold back his heroic abilities
associated_names: 勇者先生　～教え子が化物や宇宙人や謎の組織と戦っている件～

88465.synopsis:
[Soul Swap + Transmigration into a Novel + Sweet Romance Comedy + Going Crazy + Tyrant + Feel-Good Story + Both Leads Pure] 
Yun Yaoyao has transmigrated into a novel, becoming a foolish, weak, and insignificant character who doesn’t survive past the first chapter.

But after killing the emperor, Yun Yaoyao makes a shocking discovery – she and the tyrant emperor have swapped bodies!
The assassination attempt causes Emperor Tu Shanjin to transmigrate into a woman’s body, only to be thrown into a water prison for regicide!
Filled with icy rage, he vows to destroy that bewitching woman, but ends up being taken into her harem instead.
The two, each harboring ulterior motives, are forced into a temporary alliance.
However, they soon realize that the other person can easily solve their respective problems.
Yun Yaoyao as Emperor: Using her personal charm to win over loyal ministers, showing compassion to the common people, stabilizing the empire. Whoever provokes her, she’ll deal with them in unexpected ways!
Tu Shanjin as the Favored Consort: Body too weak? I’ll train! Family too vile? I’ll destroy them! Anyone who dares to cause trouble, I’ll tear them apart! Whoever offends him must die!
[Also known as: The Love Story of the Yao-Shan Couple, Adventures in Governing~]
associated_names: 她，与暴君互换后，杀疯啦！

88977.synopsis:
After a car accident, Jian Xie could suddenly see various monsters.
His insight level also jumped from the ordinary person’s D to the unique super S level, which shocked the entire supernatural world.
All the monsters flock to him like a mob on a wild goose chase.
What’s even more terrifying than the above is that—
He found out that he was sharing a body with an evil god.
It was a terrifying existence that easily crushed all monsters and made the Supernatural Management Bureau extremely wary and terrified at the mention of it.
Question: How does it feel to be the only Achilles’ heel of a temperamental evil god who does whatever he wants?
Jian Xie: “.”
To be honest, it should be considered a work-related injury.
*
What s*upid things has your cat done for you?
Answer: Worried that the owner, who didn’t know how to hunt, would starve to death, it bit a mouse to death and placed it next to the sleeping owner’s pillow.
The crucial point is that it’s even waiting to be praised with an expectant face.
When Jian Xie woke up, he found the evil spirit who was wanted by the Supernatural Management Bureau kneeling under the bed.
A certain indescribable someone raised their eyebrows and lazily said: Satisfied with what you see?
Jian Xie: “…………”

89233.synopsis:
I taught the villains to return to reality.

91025.synopsis: Seo Dan-ah, a former FPS pro-gamer, somehow found herself ensnared by a game called Idol Training Simulation. It seemed the only way to return to reality was to witness the game’s ending.

92049.synopsis: Lin Xuan accidentally traverses into the world of immortal cultivation and becomes the head of a family. He is bound to the strongest family system, which enables him to grow stronger by developing his family! Setting family rules, revising family laws, investing in his kin, and eliminating opposing forces… From then on, Lin Xuan embarks on an unstoppable path of family development. 92305.synopsis:
Abandoned by the Demonic Sect as a pawn, Nie Chen went to deliver a war letter to Empress Qingyue. He thought he would surely die, but the system awakened and unexpectedly turned the challenge letter into a love letter!
Nie Chen’s heart was filled with despair: “I really didn’t do this!”
Barely had he finished speaking when the aloof and proud Empress Qingyue blushed, her autumn eyes filled with tenderness.

When Nie Chen held Qingyue Empress’s hand and walked down the bustling street,
 [You have shocked Saintess Fanhua…… You have shocked……] 
[Empress + Pursuit + Comedy + System + Sweet + Adorably Cute Female Lead]

92817.synopsis:
I ended up inside a depressing BL novel where beastmen live.
“Beep– Beep beep beep!?”
But why, of all things, am I a weak and fragile sparrow beastman…?
Saewoo realizes that even after reaching the ending, he can’t leave the novel he’s been transmigrated into. 
So, he decides to play matchmaker for the main couple, and with the reward money he earns, he buys a building, dreaming of a peaceful retirement.
“Retirement is all about becoming a landlord.”
However, on the very first day after signing the building contract, Saewoo picks up the notorious villain in front of his house.
“P-please save me! Save me…!” 
“What’s this? You’re barely a mouthful of food.” 
“I-I-I’m not food… Aaah!”
Jibeom, seeing his pheromones all over Saewoo, mistakenly believes they had a one-night stand and even steals Saewoo’s first kiss.
In the end, Saewoo gets devoured in a completely different way.
associated_names: Even as a Sick Sparrow, I'm Still the Landlord

93841.synopsis:
In her previous life, Xia An’an was a 200-pound woman whose first love—her childhood sweetheart—had once promised to take care of her for life, only to run off with her beautiful best friend. Approaching thirty and still unable to marry, Xia An’an had resigned herself to a life of solitude.
But one day, she wakes up in another version of herself’s life. This version of “herself” is slim and beautiful—is this really her? Not only that, she now has a successful husband and an adorable little son who could melt anyone’s heart in seconds. Could life get any more perfect?
However, rumors say that in this life, she doesn’t seem to love her husband or her child. Xia An’an is furious—was her other self out of her mind? Her husband has worked himself to the bone for her, yet she doesn’t care? Her son is so well-behaved and lovable, yet she doesn’t like him?! Did she get her head slammed by a door or something?
Now, faced with a husband who silently supports her but barely gets a word from her due to “her” coldness, and a little “bun” who gazes up at her with innocent, love-craving eyes, Xia An’an decides it’s time to improve her married life…

94097.synopsis:
Xiao Banli grew up in an orphanage, and her fate was marked by three marriages and three divorces. She had a tragic life: beauty brings tragedy, men are unfaithful, and villains prosper. Her death was miserable, and she thought she would cross over into the afterlife. Unexpectedly, when she opened her eyes again, she had returned to her childhood in the orphanage.
In her previous life: she was abandoned by a man and betrayed by a woman.
In this life: she wants to live a low-key life, but ends up clashing with Yuan Muxiao, supporting Ouyang Que, and becoming a “female warrior,” finding her one true love.
Ouyang Que: What should I do? Now that you’re by my side, I can’t stay low-key anymore.
Xiao Banli: ………
Ouyang Que: I just want a single heart, to grow old without parting.

94353.synopsis:
Qin Feng travels to a parallel universe and realizes that the Earth has mutated and Elementalists have become the masters of humanity.
Qin Feng rises from the bottom, practicing all nine systems together!
He awakens the seventh sense and gains spatial abilities!
He awakens the eighth sense and gains the ability of time!
He awakens the ninth sense and gains the ability of reincarnation!
He unified the globe, established himself as Emperor Qin, refined twelve golden men, created thousands of terracotta warriors, led billions of soldiers and horses, and conquered the sea of stars…
This novel and the characters are purely fictional, such as thunder and lightning, pure coincidence, do not imitate.

全球异能：我掌控所有元素

95121.synopsis:
Jian Mo, after graduating, returns to his small hometown and opens an animal clinic.
One night, while he’s asleep, he hears a persistent thumping noise on the roof. Assuming it’s just a cat, he steps outside with a can of food to lure in a friendly, easily tricked, beautiful kitten.
The kitten is indeed stunning, but while Jian Mo is happily hugging and cuddling it, the kitten looks utterly confused. Suddenly, a booming voice interrupts him. Turning around, Jian Mo is startled to find an enormous cat, much larger than himself, standing right behind him.
The giant cat glares at Jian Mo with a raspy voice: “Let go of my brother!”
Now it’s Jian Mo’s turn to be confused.
As he looks up, he realizes the park, city streets, and cars around him have transformed into forests, snowy mountains, grasslands, and tribal settlements.
—He has crossed into a world of beastmen!
The only silver lining? He’s a veterinarian, so at least his skills are somewhat relevant. Treating animals to treating beastmen… well, with some effort, it’s not entirely impossible.
Extra Snippet:
One day, Jian Mo and his partner Wu Jiong head out to gather supplies. As they enter the forest, they hear a series of faint, rustling noises. Peeking through the gaps between the leaves, they see a group of fluffy little creatures huddled in a circle, seemingly “complaining” about him.
A chubby chick sulks: “Doctor Jian Mo said I overate and have indigestion, so I have to starve for a whole day. Chirp chirp.”
A little snow leopard with tearful eyes: “Doctor Jian Mo said I have cavities, so I can’t eat honey anymore. Waaa.”
A small beaver sniffles: “Doctor Jian Mo confiscated all my hidden snacks, saying they’d make me sick. I never want to visit his clinic again. Boohoo.”
A little Pallas’s cat glances at its companions and softly squeaks, “But… when I get treated, Doctor Jian Mo always hugs me.”
The fluffy critters fall silent, lost in thought about Jian Mo.
Behind the trees, riding on the back of his partner who has transformed into a giant wolf, Jian Mo listens to the whole conversation: “…”
The giant wolf turns to gently lick Jian Mo’s newly grown beast ears. “The little ones all came to ask me to put in a good word for them.”
Blushing from the lick, Jian Mo pushes away the fluffy wolf head, “Pleading won’t help; at most, I’ll give them some extra treats to comfort them. And you—stop licking my ears!”
Tags: Time Travel, Farming, Gourmet, Feel-Good, Adorable Pets, Infrastructure

98961.synopsis:
I have awakened a new ability.
I sell Earth’s ‘abundant’ resources and bring in ‘abundant’ resources from other worlds.
After all, the value of goods is bound to differ depending on the world

99473.synopsis:
“What exactly do you want to do with me?”
Nam Seonwoo had prepared counter-responses, expecting questions like ‘Are you saying we should date because you like me?’ or ‘How can you think about that when we’re high school seniors?’ He waited for his voice.
“I want to hold your hand.”
But the answer that came back was very different from what he’d expected.
“I want to see you without making studying an excuse. Even on weekends.”
“We’re… already doing that now.”
“But you won’t let me hold your hand.”
When he curled his fingers into his palm as if hiding them, it felt like his gaze was physically poking at his palm.
“And…”
Unlike his intensifying gaze that was almost suffocating, his following words disappeared lightly into the air.
“When I say there’s no one at home, you won’t come over.”
“…”
Seonwoo’s face burned hot at his words, which seemed to already know how extremely cautious he was about being alone with Kang Jihan in his room.
“Besides helping with cleaning or lending coins, I can do better this time.”
At these sudden words, he recalled how Kang Jihan once put a 100-won coin in the public phone and left. The clinking sound of coins in the machine, the cleanly wiped classroom blackboard. And the praise note that only said ‘good job.’
The once-clumsy secret helper revealed himself and said:
“So make me your ‘Manito’ again.”

102545.synopsis:
In an era when Guide kidnapping is rampant and even considered normal due to the shortage of Guides.
Chae Do-min, an exceptionally talented S-class Guide, is suffering from overwork,
and was waiting for a cute Esper to kidnap him.
Suddenly, a strange sense of déjà vu.
Finally, Do-min’s intuition, honed from being kidnapped at least five times, was telling him:
This is surely the appearance of an Esper who will save me from Guiding hell.
…But the Esper who has confined me is strange.
The more submissive I act, the happier they become, rather than getting bored.
Is this… right? Is it?

108945.synopsis:
I’m the kitchen maid in the treacherous minister’s household. I’m blessed with immense strength—I can do the work of three people.  
After the treacherous minister beat to death over a dozen maids who tried to sleep with him, he was left with no one to even serve him his meals.
“Go there and work hard. Don’t try to climb into his bed. Your monthly salary will be increased to five taels. If you can hold out for three years, I guarantee you’ll return home in glory! But if you try to seduce him, forget about getting the money, you’ll lose your life too…” The old steward held my hand and earnestly advised me, afraid that I might lose my mind and ruin myself.
Two years later, the treacherous minister, taking advantage of being alone, pretended to be drunk after drinking tea, and repeatedly tried to drag me onto the bed.
I kicked him over with one foot, tied myself up tightly with a rope, secured my collar and waist, even tying my pants tightly—ready to die rather than yield. 
“My lord! Let me tell you the truth today—I’d rather die than climb into that bed!”
associated_names: The Firewood Girl of the Treacherous Minister,
《权臣的黑面月光》The Dark Moonlight of a Powerful Minister (Short-Drama)

110481.synopsis:
“Because of Rei, everyone gives up, don’t they?”
Hearing such words, I thought to myself. –I thought that Natsuki could not fall in love because I was her “childhood friend” and naturally stood next to her.
So I suggested that we go our separate ways from now on. Natsuki did not pull me back. She must have been relieved that the intruder had finally left her alone.
–But the next day, she did not come to school.
This is the start of a funny and sweetly romantic comedy of differences between the insensitive protagonist, Shiraishi Rei, and his awkward childhood friend, Shinohara Natsuki!
associated_names: 幼馴染に「あんたのせいで彼氏ができない」と言われたため、距離を取ったら次の日から学校に来なくなった

115601.synopsis:
Transmigrating to an era of magic’s decline, a world of swords and sorcery, I became the second son of the Gray family, a marquis household of the Empire.
In this era where magic is dwindling, Rein Gray uses the “Book of Arts” to master every known cultivation skill in existence.
With the Book of Arts, Rein vows to pull magic back onto the summit of the world.
…
Faced with the elven queen’s boundless curiosity for all knowledge, Rein shows a meaningful smile.
“Your Majesty the Queen, I’m sure there are certain magic you want to know as well?”
To pursue unknown knowledge, the queen can only let Rein have his way.
In the dwarves’ most advanced technological city, Rein relies on memories from his previous life, prompting the dwarven king to praise him as the reincarnation of the God of Forging.
When a vicious dragon terrorizes the land and people flee in panic~
Dragon: “ROAR~ (majestic)”
Rein steps forward, “You beast, take this – Great Mighty Heavenly Dragon!”
Dragon: “Oh oh oh~ (stop hitting me! I’m sorry!)”
associated_names: 末法时代：我知晓世间所有魔法

121489.synopsis:
In the fifth year of the Qingyuan era, demons ran rampant.
Three months after the death of the Lady of the Marquis of Jinyang, a new wife entered the household, but she did not get along with the legitimate daughter born of the previous marriage.
A month later, the Marquis of Jinyang claimed the legitimate daughter was not his biological child. Out of sentiment for raising her all these years, he merely expelled her from the household without pursuing the matter of bloodline confusion.
Ji Chan was driven out of her home, gravely injured and on the brink of death.
That night, she encountered an eight-tailed fox who had fled thousands of miles from the Northern Wilderness to the capital in search of a noble title.
The fox asked her: “Do I look like a human?”
Ji Chan replied: “You look more human than all of them.”
The fox said: “Sadly, all eight of my tails have been severed. I can no longer transform into a human.”
Ji Chan said: “It’s alright. I’ll give you this body of flesh and blood. Live on in my place and take revenge for me!”
associated_names: After She Was Kicked Out of the Marquis Mansion

123025.synopsis:
Born a mutant into a cursed lineage of monsters, I lived a life of agonizing torment, forced to steal the lives of others against my will.
“I wish someone would kill me.”
One night, beneath an exceptionally bright full moon, my plea was answered.
“[When the darkness upon this world threatens to swallow even the heavens, a valiant one shall slay the serpent and end it all. Thus, peace shall be ushered in.] ”
So I spared the small child who had snuck into the monster’s mansion, desperately hoping he would grow strong and return for revenge.
And finally, on the destined day of reckoning, the one who was both my savior and the sole hero of this world shattered my hopes.
“I don’t want to kill you anymore.”
“Stay by my side. Until I die.”
associated_names: What I Can Do For the One I Love
사랑하는 너를 위해 할 수 있는 것

124817.synopsis:
After failing the postgraduate entrance exam four times, Chen Qianmiao was completely disheartened. Just as he was falling into despair, he unexpectedly turned into a magical girl.
And becoming a magical girl comes with fulfilling one big wish of the girl.
Eliminate all suffering?
Make everyone happy?
Nope, his one and only wish—get accepted!
Of course, if he had a choice, he actually didn’t want to turn into a dude-version magical girl.
But magical girls are supposed to be cute and gentle, right?
So why…
The most vicious, most ruthless, most decisive, most anti-holy mother magical girl in history has arrived.
Cultists trying to summon an evil god? Kill!
Corrupted magical girls? Kill!
The evil god itself that could destroy the world? Kill!
If I don’t screw people over, they won’t screw me over?
Screw that! I’ll f**king kill! Kill! Kill!
If the bad guys aren’t wiped out, they’ll keep hurting the good ones!
Only with thunderous means can one show a compassionate heart!
If it can be killed, don’t try to reform it.
If it can be cut down, don’t drag it out.
The mission: speedrun evil!
Yeh! You’re taking the postgrad exam too? Sh** off!!!
Ribbit! It’s a magical girl, everyone run!!!
With his power alone, he flipped the whole magical girl stereotype on its head.
He’s absolutely unbeatable!
And his magical girl ability?
Each month, he randomly draws one fictional character’s skill.
The first character he drew… was Ryomen Sukuna!
When the 114,514th villain says “I’ll win for sure,”
When they shamelessly shout out their victory declarations,
Chen Qianmiao already knows—
It’s time.
associated_names: 考研，然后变成魔法少女

125841.synopsis:
‘Why is everyone acting this way toward me!’
Connie Clarence, a new teacher who became a homeroom teacher at the kingdom’s most prestigious private school after overcoming hardships and adversities.
Though she tried to work diligently as a teacher with a sense of mission, she keeps getting strangely entangled with parents?
⁕⁕⁕Entangled Parent 1: The brother of ‘Daniella,’ who’s not just someone with a ‘princess syndrome’ case but an actual princess.
A prince who seemed…… perfect in character, perfect in appearance, and excellent in manners
“The classroom looks quite pretty.”
“Ah, yes. Thank you.”
Connie also looked around the classroom following the prince’s gaze and nodded with a slight smile, but……
“Perhaps because it resembles its owner……”
Owner? The owner of the classroom?
Ah…… you mean the children? That’s what you mean, right?
⁕⁕⁕Entangled Parent 2: The father of the model student ‘William,’ a widowed duke who is the sexiest single father in the kingdom
“You seem to really like children, Teacher.”
“Yes, of course.”
Connie smiled brightly and answered Duke Wayne’s obvious question.
“What if William were not your student but your son?”
“Ah, that would make me so happy…… What?”
“Please answer me, Connie…… Teacher Clarence.”
It’s just a meaningless hypothetical, so why is your gaze so serious, ‘Father’?
⁕⁕⁕Entangled Parent 3: The uncle of troublemaker ‘Callian,’ a wealthy, pretty-faced count with a tr*sh personality
“Is it okay for a teacher to lie like that?”
This pretty and rich piece of tr*sh is starting again.
“What do you mean?”
“That you like men who apologize well and don’t hit others—that’s a complete lie.”
“A lie? It’s actually true!”
“I doubt it. I never apologize and I hit people often, yet women all love me. They cling to me so much it’s annoying.”
How did he end up like this…… This is why education is truly important.
I really need to teach my class children well!
So, parents! Please stop entangling me in strange ways.
I’m a teacher, and you all are parents!

128145.synopsis:
Her boyfriend is getting married—to a rich woman.
Betrayed by her longtime lover, Seung-ah moves into a mansion.
But the mansion’s owner, Han Yujin, is no ordinary man.
“I thought you’d look beautiful even when you cry.”
“I’m not that weak.”
“No, I mean… under me.”
He makes a dangerously tempting proposal:
“The role is my fiancée.
The duration: one year.
The reward: this house.”
Though shaken by the luxurious mansion,
Seung-ah soon finds herself being drawn to Yujin.
“I’ll seduce you every chance I get. Because I need you.”
A one-of-a-kind “Get My Own Home” project!
But… is this contract really okay?Excerpt
Yujin set down his half-finished glass of wine. His straight, pale fingers reached toward Seung-ah’s cheek.
“I’m confident I can kiss better than Kim Tae-jun.”
“Are we even in that kind of relationship…? What do we even know about each other?”
“That’s why it’s more thrilling, isn’t it?”
He leaned in—gentle yet without hesitation.

130961.synopsis:
Lu Chuan, whose family was said to be poor for three generations and who was practically possessed by the soul of a pauper, spent his life praying, “I don’t ask for even a shred of true love, I only ask for wealth and glory.”
He finally moved Heaven’s Grandma to tears.
The God of Wealth System descended upon him, with the goal of turning him into the God of Wealth of a new world!
The problem was… this new world was the Infinite Worlds.
——————————————
In the Infinite Game World, horrors abound.
Here, the rich scramble desperately to spend money on life-saving items.
Only the game’s number one ranked player, [Here Comes the God of Wealth] , goes against the flow.
All the players know: if you want to buy survival items, you go to the God of Wealth!
Until one day, they discover… even NPCs think the same way.
“Money is born sinful. I am the man who can bear that sin.”
“Those who don’t love money—money doesn’t love them either.”
“Money isn’t money. It’s the unfulfilled desire you can’t attain.”
“If money can’t solve something, it just means there isn’t enough of it.”
—by Lu Chuan, the hopeless money-grubber.
Tags: Infinite Stream · System · Power Fantasy · Growth
Protagonists: Lu Chuan, Cang Jiu
One-line summary: Be the master of money, not its s*ave.
Theme: Money isn’t your master—you are your own master.

149137.synopsis:
Orphaned high schooler becomes a total loner after losing parents in an accident.
His first-love classmate, down from her parents’ divorce, finds solace in his unassuming charm—tall, smart, quietly kind.
What starts as pure romance spirals: study sessions turn steamy, swimmers join in, stalkers lurk.
In modern Japan, one loner’s humanity builds an unexpected harem.
associated_names: Bocchi no Junai Monogatari no Hazu datta noni...
ボッチの純愛物語のはずだったのに・・・

161169.synopsis:
Bittersweet yet fresh—science, love, and mystery.
When you think about it, “youth” is a lot like a well-crafted detective novel.
“Should we continue what we started back then… at Arima’s house?”
Watase Maria is a beautiful girl who is immensely popular with the boys, and Arima Shunta is a geeky high school freshman. The two are childhood friends who have played together every day for as long as they can remember.
Though they had grown distant due to an “incident” back in their second year of middle school, they find themselves sitting next to each other after a seat reshuffle in high school.
One day, Maria suddenly asks him, “If you want to see my breasts, should I show them to you?”
After school, in Shunta’s room, Maria says, “I’ll only show my body to you, Shunta,” and begins to take off her uniform, revealing her developed chest right in front of him…
A naughty youth rom-com featuring a childhood friend who has grown a seductive body.

206737.synopsis:
Today was the day Crown Prince Arden Fairtrach ascended the throne as Emperor of the Ampherion Empire.
The Emperor Emeritus gazed proudly at his newly enthroned son and made a joke.
“Now, all you need to do is find a partner to stand beside you.”
“There is no need to look. I’ve already decided on someone.”
At the Emperor’s confident reply, the nobles’ and the Emperor Emeritus’s eyes widened slightly in surprise.
Just which household’s noble lady had managed to get that frivolous fool under her thumb?
She was surely from an illustrious family, exceptionally beautiful, and capable as well!
Under the expectant and curious gazes focused entirely upon him, the Emperor rose from his seat as soon as he finished speaking and approached a beautiful young man with black hair.
“Marry me.”
“Pffft!”
The finest wine sprayed from the Emperor Emeritus’s mouth.
